new_claims.statement_short: For A=RDR^T exact rank r>2 and heavy set H={i:||R_i||^2>theta}, epsilon=||R_H^T R_H||op, either epsilon<=1-2theta and ||p_Q||inf <= [4r/(r-2)]/[(1-epsilon)L] <=6/(theta L) with continuous C0 density, or a unit v in Ran(A) has >1-2theta mass on H and |H|<r/theta.

partner_application.application: After conditioning heavy original coordinates and exact Gram whitening, surviving leverage <=theta/(1-epsilon)<=1/2; partner h=0 gives 4r/(r-2)|det K|^{-1/r}. Exact det K=det(G)det(D) yields the bound; at r=3, theta=1/4, ||p_Q||inf<=24/L.
